item_alpha.case: Successfully paint17007 red, pick or harvest it with its saved painted state; inspect a tintindex0 quad in the ordinary item model.
item_alpha.limit: Neo ordinary tinted-quad path only. No final GPU image, shader-pack/addon behavior or claim that overlay/untinted quads disappear.

positive_routes: Both nodes configure BlockEntityPaintMixin and client BlockPaintColorMixin/ItemPaintColorMixin.
17007 original material initialization addsDCDC96 before the paintable tile reads it; this is not inferred from the material name.
Main valve save/load explicitly calls its ancestor; mixin writesgt.painted/gt.color, native saveWithoutMetadata/saveWithId routes throughsaveAdditional.
Current main-valve getDrops/clone stores that data; CoverDrops.capture explicitly excludes it from machine data removal.
Unpainted block-color lookup falls back to the registered material handler. The white refusal does not mean every unpainted block is visually white.
remaining: All other entity override/save/drop chains and dedicated renderers, actual paint/unpaint/restart, native item alpha image/third-party shaders, complete painting entity/grass/vanilla target policy and remaining original systems.
